checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check (no script re-sent) against the previously reported Escape-to-close bug (iteration_4). Flow: login -> click global-search-input -> panel opens (global-search-panel visible) -> fill 'Dashboard' -> panel still visible with filtered result -> press Escape -> expect(global-search-panel).not.toBeVisible() PASSED. Reproduced twice consecutively (2 separate runs, both PASSED), confirming the fix in GlobalSearch.tsx is resolved and not flaky. Screenshots: opened-empty, typed-dashboard, closed-after-escape.
